causalConclusion.ablation: Removing only the candidate cache and empty-projection shortcut reproduces the Base work-count failure; restoring reproduces PASS and exact response equality.
causalConclusion.base: L-A and L-C each scan 293505 binding-version entries across one evaluation; 146625 occur on 575 consecutive calls with the same source order, early-binding set, and projected execution-position ID set. L-A rebuilds 36288 candidate IDs on those states. All 575 dynamic readiness output sets remained unchanged in this frozen request, which is diagnostic only and does not establish that graph queries are redundant.
causalConclusion.fixed: L-A scans 146880 version entries across 576 unique selection states, reuses 36288 candidate IDs, and scans zero version entries on repeated selection states. L-C scans zero entries because its projected execution-position set is empty. L-B already has no binding-version scan.
causalConclusion.readiness: The dependency-readiness graph is still queried on every call: 1151 L-A/L-C calls and 513 L-B calls. No readiness decisions are cached.
causalConclusion.timingCaveat: The Rust timing series include cfg(test) collectors and show high variation; no production speedup is claimed.
